item.title: Rumor: Tigers, Dodgers Have Agreed on Framework for Blockbuster Tarik Skubal Trade
item.description: A new rumor claims the Detroit Tigers and Dodgers have the framework of a Tarik Skubal trade agreed to. Only one hurdle reportedly remains. The post Rumor: Tigers, Dodgers Have Agreed on Framework for Blockbuster Tarik Skubal Trade appeared first on Detroit Sports Nation.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Sign Kyle Finnegan to Multi-Year Deal
item.description: The Detroit Tigers have re-signed right-handed reliever Kyle Finnegan to a two-year, $19 million deal at the Winter Meetings. The post Detroit Tigers Sign Kyle Finnegan to Multi-Year Deal appeared first on Detroit Sports Nation.

item.description: Scott Boras didn’t hold back at the Winter Meetings, saying the Tigers become a “Mystery Machine” without ace Tarik Skubal. The post Scott Boras Reveals Directions Tarik Skubal Gave Him Regarding Detroit Tigers appeared first on Detroit Sports Nation.
